p.src: 1  Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

ja: っておられるのか。 なぜあなたは
en: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
u.src: 1  Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

p.src: 2  In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

ja: らがたくらんだ悪計に、彼らを
en: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
u.src: 2  In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

p.src: 3  For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.

en: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.
u.src: 3  For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.

zh: 10:3 或譯：他祝福貪財的，卻輕慢耶和華

p.src: 4  The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

en: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
u.src: 4  The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

p.src: 5  His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

ja: えている。 彼は傲慢で、あなたの掟は
から遠く離れている。 彼は自分のすべての
en: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
u.src: 5  His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

p.src: 6  He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

ja: るがされることはない。
々にわたって、私は苦難に
en: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
u.src: 6  He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

p.src: 7  His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

en: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
u.src: 7  His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

p.src: 8  He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

en: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
u.src: 8  He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

p.src: 9  He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

ja: は隠れ場にいる獅子のように、ひそかに
せする。 彼は寄る辺のない
en: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
u.src: 9  He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

p.src: 10  The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

ja: は打ち砕かれる。 彼らは倒れ込む。 彼らは
en: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
u.src: 10  The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

p.src: 11  He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

en: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
u.src: 11  He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

p.src: 12  Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

ja: げてください。 寄る辺のない
en: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
u.src: 12  Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

p.src: 13  Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

ja: で「神は私を問いたださない」と
en: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
u.src: 13  Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

p.src: 14  But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

ja: しかし、あなたは苦難と悲しみを
ておられる。 あなたはそれを
に引き受けるために、顧みてくださる。 あなたは犠牲者と父なし子を
en: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
u.src: 14  But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

p.src: 15  Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

ja: を折ってください。 悪を行う者については、その
つからなくなるまで探し出してください。
en: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
u.src: 15  Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

p.src: 16  The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

en: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
u.src: 16  The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

p.src: 17  LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

ja: よ、あなたはへりくだる
を備えられる。 あなたは御
en: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
u.src: 17  LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

p.src: 18  to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

ja: がもはや恐れさせないためだ。
en: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
u.src: 18  to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
